name: jevkeep
description: Codex plugin that preserves useful conversation excerpts alongside the summary after context compaction.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve useful conversation text through Codex compaction.
interface.longDescription: When Codex condenses a long conversation into a summary, JevKeep restores selected original text alongside it, including useful commands, errors, file paths, and decisions. Works with manual and automatic compaction. Requires Node.js 22+ and a Typesafe API key.
defaultPrompt: Explain how JevKeep preserves historical excerpts across compaction.
